checks.note: a0101 names 'a method using the distance formula' as one of the two ways to prove collinearity; a0103 spells out the step explicitly: to prove collinearity 'using the distance formula, we must calculate the distances between each pair of points' and compare sums; a0108 (WE9) then executes exactly that step, computing d_AB, d_BC, d_AC via the distance formula (leaving results as surds, e.g. sqrt(13), sqrt(52)) and using those distances to conclude collinearity. All three quotes are present verbatim in the anchored text, and together they show the dst objective (determine collinearity via distance method) using the src objective's method (distance formula, surd form) as a direct computational step, not just a shared topic word.
